acceptance_criteria: share_with serializes as null when None. cargo test -p jmap-contacts-types exits 0.
close_reason: Removed skip_serializing_if from AddressBook.share_with; added two new serialization tests; contacts-10 §2 types this as Id[AddressBookRights]|null
description:
**What:** Remove skip_serializing_if from AddressBook.share_with in crate-jmap-contacts-types/src/addressbook.rs. Spec draft-ietf-jmap-contacts-10 §2 types shareWith as Id[AddressBookRights]|null — a required-nullable field. The §4.1 example shows "shareWith": null when not shared. The current skip_serializing_if omits the field entirely when None.

**Algorithm:**
1. In addressbook.rs, change the share_with field from:
   #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
   pub share_with: Option<HashMap<Id, AddressBookRights>>,
   to:
   #[serde(default)]
   pub share_with: Option<HashMap<Id, AddressBookRights>>,
   (Remove only skip_serializing_if; keep #[serde(default)] so absent key during deserialization gives None.)
2. Add test address_book_share_with_null_serializes: construct AddressBook with share_with: None, serialize, assert JSON contains "shareWith":null (not absent). Oracle: spec §4.1 second address book example.
3. Add test address_book_share_with_some_serializes: deserialize the §4.1 first address book example JSON (with a shareWith map), re-serialize, assert the map round-trips with correct principal id and rights.
4. Run cargo test -p jmap-contacts-types.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- No unwrap in library code.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- serde_json::to_value(&ab) where ab.share_with is None produces JSON with "shareWith": null present.
- Existing address_book_share_with_null (deserialization) test still passes.
- cargo test -p jmap-contacts-types exits 0. Clippy clean.
title: Fix AddressBook.share_with serializes as null not absent
